title: Optimized Lookup Problems
definition: Trading O(N) space to achieve O(1) lookup time. Used heavily in problems like 'Valid Sudoku' or 'Longest Consecutive Sequence'.
simpleExplanation: Using a massive amount of scratch paper so you never have to calculate the same math problem twice.
